context7.$comment: Up-to-date library documentation and code examples via Context7. Runs on the anonymous free tier (IP-based rate limits) by default. To raise limits, get a free API key at context7.com and `export CONTEXT7_API_KEY=...` in your shell profile — the login shell passes it through and the command below picks it up. If Context7 is unavailable, bts skills fall back to official-domain WebFetch per bts-evidence-policy.md.
